page.layout: One printed page, text in one column; running head at the top centre; no margin notes; catchword at the lower right ("ful-" is a line-end hyphenated word, not a catchword).

main_text.p: Belgiū obumbrares, atque ab hostilis, Sæuitiæ ardore defenderes. Testes sunt tot profligati Hispanorū exercitus, tot concisę acies, albentibusque hostium ossibus campi infecti, cruore flumina; Testis Belgica vniuersa, quæ te totiēs fortis imperatoris, strenuique militis fungentem officio, hostilique sanguine per fusum adspexit: Testes denique hę miserę temporum conditiones, quas consilio, virtute, prudentia, fortitudine animi, e depositis propemodum ac deploratis, in eumque hodie cerniturstatum reduxisti; vnde te merito Patrem, Patriæ, nulliq; veterum secundum appellamus. Quibus de cautis, quin debeatur nomini vestro Illustrissimi DD. Princeps inuictissime, hoc belgici belli monumentum, nemini dubium esse potest. page.notes: Catchword "ful-" at the foot is the hyphenated line-end of "fulgentem"-type word; the page ends mid-word. Printed text is set in roman type with long s and ligature-like "ct" forms; some letters (e.g. "Testis", "cerniturstatum") read as printed. The scan is slightly curved on the right; words near the edge were read with care.
